blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–TNT drew big performances from the returning Calvin Oftana and new import Nick Hornsby in blowing out Terrafirma, 116-92, on Wednesday in the resumption of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Oftana fired 31 points in his first game back with the team while Hornbsy added 26 to power the Tropang 5G into a crucial win that boosted their chances of securing a quarterfinals berth as one of the top four teams in Group A. The Tropang 5G improved to 5-4, sharing third place with the Converge FiberXers. The victory also allowed them to further separate themselves […]...
